channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ministro brasileiro e representante dos EUA retomam conversas após telefonema de Lula e Trump
item.description: Brazilian Minister Marcio Elias Rosa and U.S. representative Jamieson Greer agreed to resume technical negotiations on tariffs next Monday, following a call between Presidents Lula and Trump. The move marks a concrete outcome of the presidential conversation.

item.title: É #FAKE que PF descobriu 'fábrica de fake news' criada para beneficiar Flávio Bolsonaro; foto foi feita com inteligência artificial
item.description: An AI-generated image falsely depicting a Federal Police raid on a 'fake news factory' in Diadema, SP, allegedly benefiting Flávio Bolsonaro, has gone viral. Both the Federal Police and the São Paulo Public Security Secretariat denied the operation ever took place, confirming the photo is synthetic and the claim is false.

item.title: Moraes diz que IA 'anabolizou' desinformação e indica cassação por mau uso
item.description: Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes stated that Artificial Intelligence has acted as an 'anabolic' for disinformation, intensifying the problem. He pledged to revoke the candidacies of candidates who misuse AI for disinformation purposes in the final stretch of elections. The statement signals a tougher stance by the Electoral Court against the malicious use of new technologies in the electoral process.

item.title: PEC que acaba com a escala 6x1 chega à CCJ, e governo Lula emplaca aliado na relatoria
item.description: The constitutional amendment proposals to end the 6x1 work scale and to address public security have reached the Senate's CCJ committee, where the Lula government has installed allied rapporteurs. The proposals are expected to be voted on in the first week of September, before the upcoming election.

item.title: Lula cai para apenas 28% de aprovação no Lulômetro
item.description: Lula's approval dropped from 30% to 28% in the Lulômetro, while 'bad' and 'poor' ratings rose from 36% to 38%. 32% rate his performance as regular.

item.title: Em Madri, Lulinha mora em condomínio de luxo com piscinas, spa e sauna
item.description: President Lula's son Fábio Luís (Lulinha) lives in a luxury Madrid condo renting for €3,000/month in the upscale La Moraleja neighborhood, also home to soccer star Vinícius Jr. He is under investigation by the Federal Police in three separate probes for corruption and influence peddling, with ties to lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: Crusoé: A última reunião dos militares nos estertores do governo Bolsonaro
item.description: Former FAB commander Carlos Baptista Júnior will release his book 'Eu disse não: uma trincheira antigolpista' in September, discussing Jair Bolsonaro's refusal to accept the 2022 election results and his attempts to rally military support. The book details the final meetings between the former president and high-ranking military officials.

item.title: Ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula pediu pintura de 100 mil euros de presente a lobista: ‘E meu quadro?’
item.description: Lula's former chief of staff requested a €100,000 painting as a gift from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who was brokering business deals with the government. He acknowledged receiving R$217,000 in expenses and a R$249,000 'loan,' while the Federal Police investigate alleged influence peddling involving the president and his son.

item.title: Crusoé: Zema chama João Campos de “intocável das bets”
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB), calling him the 'untouchable of Bets'. Zema accused Campos' administration of promoting betting houses' advertising and labeled him the 'TikTok mayor of Pernambuco'.

item.title: Relator quer apresentar parecer a favor do fim da 6x1 em duas semanas
item.description: The rapporteur for the PEC to end the 6x1 work shift, Omar Aziz, plans to present his report on the admissibility of the proposal during the week of August 31. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded the proposal to the CCJ after 85 days of delay, as the government seeks to expedite key priorities ahead of the October elections.

item.title: PF diz que Lulinha é citado como ‘destinatário de pagamentos’ de empresário com interesse no governo
item.description: Brazilian Federal Police are investigating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), son of President Lula, on suspicion of influence trafficking. According to a PF report, Lulinha appears in conversations as a recipient of payments from businessman Cléber Ribas, who sought contracts at Dataprev and the Ministry of Social Development, with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger acting as intermediary. The PF has opened specific inquiries regarding Dataprev and the Ministry of Health to investigate the matter.

item.title: ‘Somos governo, tem que pedir tudo e fazer’, disse lobista amiga de Lulinha
item.description: PF investigation reveals messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger demonstrating influence peddling in the Lula government. She states "we are the government, you have to ask for everything and make it happen" and details operations to appoint allies to strategic positions like the Port of Santos, involving Lulinha and businessman Fernando Bittar.

item.title: Julgamento sobre mudanças na Lei da Ficha Limpa deve ser retomado em setembro no STF
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) will resume in September the trial on changes to the Clean Record Law, which shorten the ineligibility period for convicted politicians. Some ministers have already voted to declare the amendments unconstitutional, calling them a legal setback. The ruling could impact candidates such as Anthony Garotinho, José Roberto Arruda, and Eduardo Cunha.

item.title: Ricardo Nunes rejeita candidatura de Marçal e diz que todos deveriam se unir contra o PT
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) rejects Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy and advocates unity against the PT, while supporting Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign.

item.title: Economistas apontam caminhos para futuro do Brasil no IDP Debates
item.description: On the first day of IDP Debates in São Paulo, economists discussed Brazil's future for 2026, highlighting that compensatory redistribution has reached its limits and that the country must rethink its political economy to overcome poverty. Samuel Pessoa and Zeina Latiff outlined paths for a more structural country project, moderated by Carlos Melo, João Bachur, and Andreza Matais. The event was free and held at IDP Faria Lima.

item.title: Delegado da PF tenta apreender boneco contra Lula no RN
item.description: A PF delegate asked protesters, including deputy General Girão, to deflate a Lula effigy in Natal, citing potential defamation, but backed off after debate. The protest took place during the president's campaign stop in Rio Grande do Norte ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gilmar destrava julgamento da nova Lei da Ficha Limpa que pode beneficiar Cunha, Cabral e Garotinho
item.description: Justice Gilmar Mendes released for judgment at the STF the case challenging the 2025 changes to the Clean Record Law approved by Congress. The new rules reduce ineligibility periods and could allow convicted politicians like Eduardo Cunha, Anthony Garotinho, and Sérgio Cabral to run in 2026. Rapporteur Cármen Lúcia and Justice Luiz Fux have voted against the changes, viewing them as a setback for administrative probity.

item.title: Fred viaja com o Galo para Porto Alegre e pode estrear contra o Inter
item.description: Fred, recently signed by Atlético-MG, may make his debut against Internacional at Beira-Rio, while Galo aims to win and move closer to the top five in the Brasileirão. The midfielder, who began his career at the club before playing abroad, replaces Victor Hugo, who is injured. With 10 matches unbeaten, Eduardo Domínguez's team needs a win away from home to advance in the playoff race.

item.title: Daniela Lima: Situação de Marcola é mais grave do que a de Lulinha
item.description: Daniela Lima assessed that the situation of Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, former chief of staff to President Lula, is more serious than that of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. The columnist made this comparison in her analysis on UOL News.

item.title: Moraes determina cassação da aposentadoria de Silvinei Vasques, ex-diretor da PRF
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the cancellation of the pension of Silvinei Vasques, former head of the Federal Highway Police convicted for involvement in an anti-democratic plot that operated to hinder the transport and voting of citizens during the second round of the 2022 elections. The conduct included directing roadblocks and carrying out operations with misuse of public resources, as well as illegal monitoring of authorities. After escaping custody, Vasques was arrested in Paraguay and handed over to Brazilian authorities to serve his sentence at the Papuda women's prison.

item.title: Alcolumbre despacha PECs da 6x1 e da Segurança à CCJ do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded the 6×1 clock scale and Public Security PECs to the CCJ after meeting with Lula. The proposals had been stalled for months at the Senate presidency.

item.title: Caiado ataca eficácia de políticas sociais de Lula: "Colapso completo"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) harshly criticized Lula's social mobility policies, calling them a 'total collapse,' during an event at the São Paulo market. Despite the criticism, he said he would keep the Bolsa Família program if elected, calling it a matter of state policy. He also attacked Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for skipping the presidential debate, labeling them 'fraudsters' and pushing for mandatory participation.

item.title: Crusoé: Carlos Viana aciona PF e PGR para saber onde está Lulinha
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD), former president of the INSS CPI, filed requests with the Federal Police and the Attorney General's Office to determine the whereabouts of entrepreneur Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, and to confirm whether he is available for investigations. Viana stated he seeks transparency and clarity regarding Lulinha's stance in ongoing probes. The move was announced during a press conference on Friday morning.

item.title: Diálogo entre Lula e Trump é boa notícia, com resultados práticos ainda incertos, diz analista
item.description: The phone call between Lula and Trump is seen as a positive step for bilateral relations, though analysts caution that practical impact on tariffs and policies will be limited. The cordiality established between the leaders eases tensions, while final decisions appear to be delegated to Marco Rubio, whose stance is ideologically aligned with the Brazilian opposition.

item.title: PT já vê melhora de Jerônimo e acredita que ida de Lula a Bahia será protelada
item.description: The PT leadership believes that the acceptance of Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, running for reelection in Bahia, has improved, which should postpone President Lula's trip to the state. The party considers that the urgency of a presidential visit has dissipated, as Jerônimo reportedly has strong support in the interior, having met with 363 of the 417 mayors. There is also a reading that opposition figure ACM Neto is close to his electoral ceiling.

item.title: Campanha no 2º turno tende a ser fria, diz diretor da Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: Murilo Hidalgo, director of Paraná Pesquisas, predicts the 2026 presidential election will go to a second round, with a 'cold' campaign due to first-round gubernatorial races in key states. He warned this will increase voter abstention and decrease overall engagement.

item.title: Flávio faz ato na Baixada Fluminense e discursa contra narcoterrorismo
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a rally in Nova Iguaçu, in the Baixada Fluminense region, where he pledged to combat 'narco-terrorism' if elected president. The event featured Rio governor candidate Douglas Ruas (PL), and Flávio blamed the growth of organized crime on President Lula's (PT) administration.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita obras de duplicação da ponte São Raimundo
item.description: President Lula visited the São Raimundo bridge duplication works on BR-116 in Governador Valadares, with R$309 million in investments and 2,000 jobs generated, accompanied by Transport Minister George Santoro. The project, 70% complete, includes a new 477-meter bridge and 9 km of road duplication.

item.title: Otto Alencar acerta com Alcolumbre relatores das PECs da Segurança e Fim da escala 6 X 1
item.description: Otto Alencar agreed with Davi Alcolumbre on the rapporteurs for the PECs ending the 6x1 work shift and on Public Security. Omar Aziz will handle the first, while Rogério Carvalho will take the second. The proposals were sent to the CCJ and are seen as strategic for Lula's campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai à Fiesp
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will visit Fiesp in São Paulo on Monday (24/8) to address directors during the final 30 minutes of the entity's ordinary board meeting. The meeting starts at 5 PM and ends at 7 PM, following similar engagements by Alckmin and Tarcísio.

item.title: MP Eleitoral impugna candidatura de Gustavo Rocha a vice de Celina Leão no DF
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office challenged the candidacy of Gustavo Rocha for vice-governor of the DF because he performed duties as Civil House secretary after the mandated resignation deadline. The case is under review by the TRE-DF, and if the ticket is elected, the Prosecutor's Office requests preventing his inauguration.

item.title: Flávio investe no discurso da segurança e em ataques a Lula no Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro emphasized public security and the fight against organized crime during a rally in Nova Iguaçu, while attacking Lula for allegedly protecting criminals and rising violence against women. He pledged to maintain and improve Bolsa Família and stated that Brazil needs a new political phase, asserting that voters cannot endure another four years of PT.

item.title: Caiado: “Não tenho dificuldade em aceitar redução da carga de trabalho”
item.description: Candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated he supports reducing the work week from 44 to 40 hours, but criticizes the electoral manner in which the constitutional amendment was proposed. He advocates for dialogue between employers and workers to discuss labor law changes. Caiado argues that economic measures should not be used as an election tool.

item.title: Gilmar devolve vista e ação sobre Ficha Limpa será julgada em setembro
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes returned the case on the relaxation of the Clean Record Law after requesting a view, with a trial scheduled for September at the STF. Two votes have already been cast against loosening the rules, which could allow convicted politicians to return to the 2026 elections.

item.title: “Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a receber visitas na prisão domiciliar”
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to receive visitors at his home detention, reversing a 30-day suspension due to misuse of social media. Restrictions on internet use, political-electoral activities, and a specific ban on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro remain in effect. The ruling upholds the sentence imposed in the coup plot case, where Bolsonaro was sentenced to 27 years and three months in prison.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha vê prejuízos “irreversíveis” com vazamentos
item.description: Lulinha's defense celebrated a STF ruling ordering an investigation into leaked information related to influence peddling probes involving the president's son, while warning of irreversible damages. The lawyer criticized the political use of these leaks in the electoral context and contrasted the treatment with that of Flávio Bolsonaro, who faces allegations of corruption and militia ties.

item.title: Pimenta diz que vice de Flávio é “pagamento” por proteção na CPI do INSS
item.description: Federal deputy Paulo Pimenta (PT) claimed that Alfredo Gaspar's selection as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate in the 2026 elections was a 'payment' for protecting the Bolsonaro family during the INSS CPI. He alleged that Gaspar, who served as the commission's rapporteur, blocked investigations linking the INSS scheme to Flávio Bolsonauro's circle.

item.title: STF deve retomar em setembro julgamento sobre mudança na Lei da Ficha Limpa que pode impactar campanhas
item.description: The STF will resume in September the trial regarding changes to the Clean Record Law approved by Congress, which shorten the ineligibility period for convicted candidates. Two justices have already voted against the changes, deeming them a setback to integrity rules. The ruling may affect campaigns of politicians such as José Roberto Arruda, Anthony Garotinho, and Eduardo Cunha.

item.title: Moraes autoriza retomada de visitas de Carlos e Jair Renan a Bolsonaro; veto a Flávio continua
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the resumption of visits by Carlos Bolsonaro and Jair Renan to former president Jair Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest, after the suspension period ended. Flávio Bolsonaro remains barred for 90 days as punishment for livestreaming a reading of his father's letter. Moraes conditioned the visits on a ban on any political-electoral use.

item.title: Progressistas destina R$ 1 milhão à campanha de Celina Leão
item.description: The Progressive Party (PP) donated R$1 million to the campaign of Celina Leão, governor of the Federal District running for re-election, leading voter intention polls by Real Time Big Data. The survey, registered with the TSE, shows Celina at 34%, followed by José Roberto Arruda (22%) and Leandro Grass (18%). The party is led by Senator Ciro Nogueira, under investigation in the Compliance Zero operation.

item.title: Lula aposta em canal de alto nível com Trump, que propõe reunião entre equipes o mais brevemente possível
item.description: In a 1h20 phone call with Donald Trump, Lula discussed the US tariffs on Brazil and proposed cooperation against organized crime, avoiding the classification of criminal groups as terrorists. Trump agreed on preserving strong commercial ties and suggested that teams from both countries meet as soon as possible. The conversation takes place at a critical moment in bilateral relations, on the eve of Brazil's presidential election, amid concerns about potential US interference.

item.title: PT prepara ofensiva nas redes sobre relação de Flávio com Vorcaro em meio a ataques por caso Lulinha
item.description: PT is directing its militants and allies to escalate online attacks against Flávio Bolsonaro, leveraging his ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro and the Dark Horse film case. The strategy aims to shift Lula's campaign off the defensive following attacks over Lulinha and Marcola, including revived memes like 'Tariflávio' and 'Fláviorcaro'.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Carlos e Jair Renan a retomarem visitas a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Carlos and Jair Renan Bolsonaro to resume visits to former president Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest after serving a 30-day suspension for violating precautionary measures. The visits will follow previously established schedules and security rules, with a ban on disseminating any political-electoral content. Any new violation could lead to stricter measures, including reversal to closed prison regime.

item.title: PT deve fazer campanha por atenção do eleitorado às eleições de deputados e senadores
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) is planning a campaign to raise voter awareness about the importance of congressional elections, arguing that the current legislature blocked key government measures. The strategy aims to 'educate' voters without reviving the 'enemy Congress' narrative, as Lula is currently on good terms with Senate chief Davi Alcolumbre and House chief Hugo Motta.

item.title: O que foi mais celebrado pelo governo Lula na conversa com Trump
item.description: Lula discussed with Trump the resumption of dialogue between governments and the reopening of negotiations, especially on tariffs, aiming to create a positive climate for bilateral cooperation.

item.title: ‘O estrago já está feito’: como o caso Lulinha deve abalar a disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The Lulinha case is expected to be used as an electoral weapon by the opposition against Lula, particularly by Flávio Bolsonaro, linking it to the INSS scandal. Analysts note that the political damage has already occurred, even without the conclusion of investigations.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes libera visitas de Carlos e Jair Renan a Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized the resumption of visits by Carlos and Jair Renan to their father Jair Bolsonaro, currently serving house arrest, after the suspension period expired. Flávio Bolsonaro remains barred, and any violation may result in a return to the closed regime.

item.title: A pretensa ‘transição’ de Flávio Bolsonaro na Presidência e o aceno a Tarcísio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL candidate for President, hinted at being a 'transition president', aligning with Tarcísio de Freitas' backing of electoral reform. This move reflects Flávio's effort to position himself as a temporary leader, while Tarcísio reinforces support for the constitutional amendment ending reelection.

item.title: Os EUA e as eleições brasileiras
item.description: The article by Roberto Amaral, political scientist and former minister, discusses United States influence on the 2026 Brazilian elections. The author analyzes the geopolitical context and possible external interference in the national democratic process.

item.title: Líder do governo no Senado pede informações à PGR e à PF sobre investigações do caso Dark Horse
item.description: The Senate government leader, Teresa Leitão, requested information from the PGR and PF regarding the 'Dark Horse' case, which investigates the funding of a film about Jair Bolsonaro. The parliamentarian questioned procedures related to an alleged transfer of 134 million reais from banker Daniel Vorcaro, involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.
